limitations: Agent-authored source-backed judgments are not a precision benchmark. Independent Korean-language review and contextual sense selection remain pending.
The twelve shortened-expression entries have broader notes than long intention expansions. COV-017aw remains open; no global lexical adjective conflict is inferred.

The two assumption endings 86544/86601 license adjective/copula and past/modal hypotheses for 으려니 independently of its intention expression. One morphological path can carry multiple senses; no implicit 하다 is inserted.

Honorific composition and connective/final particle slots use productive patterns. The absence of past/modal notes for 으려니까 is represented by its narrower reviewed license; full-expression and contextual comparisons remain under COV-017aw.
Bare copula 려더라 is excluded while explicit past/modal boundaries remain available. Source-attested omitted 이 before 려니 is implemented; wider omitted-copula variants need separate review.
The source word 유학가려면서 has a raw 유학가다 path but no such dictionary headword; filters remove it. 어두워지려니까 and 좋아지려던 have compositional auxiliary 지다 paths.
Corpus reports preserve original spelling and gold, including 재견되려던 versus 재건되다, 상점이고 without copula gold, and the Matsunaga name split. Training fixtures are regressions, not held-out validation.
The novel additions include alternative copula and irregular hypotheses, such as 하+이다 at 하였으려니 and 낳다 at 나려니. A headword match is not contextual validation; lexical irregular review remains COV-021d.
Nix validation is on x86_64-linux only; other declared systems are not tested.
